issue_context.title: Add end to end tests for api search functionality
issue_context.body:
# 📚 Docs or angular.io bug report ### Description Add end to end tests for api search functionality on https://angular.io/api. On adding a new status in search by status found out we are testing it only by unit tests @gkalpak suggested that we should have some e2e tests for testing this functionality created this issue to keep tabs on that. https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/34981#discussion_r374853453 ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction ### What's the affected URL?** https://angular.io/api ### Reproduction Steps** ### Expected vs Actual Behavior** ## 📷Screenshot ## 🔥 Exception or Error
## 🌍 Your Environment ### Browser info ### Anything else relevant?
comments: @gkalpak there seems to be no file for end to end tests for api page should I create a new file for that

If it is just a couple of tests, then you can put them in [app.e2e-spec.ts][1]. Otherwise, you can create a new file, yes.

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/b2222e7e0/aio/tests/e2e/src/app.e2e-spec.ts

review_comments:
Can you also verify that certain results where there before but are removed after applying the search terms?
(Similar for the tests below.)

Now that we have this `api-list.e2e-spec.ts` file, consider renaming `api.e2e-spec.ts` to `api-pages.e2e-spec.ts` to make it a little less ambiguous. Alternatively, you could merge this file into `api.e2e-spec.ts` and have two `describe()` blocks, one for the API list and one for API pages.
